sentences.text: Case :- Matters Under Article 227 No. - 5427 of 2024

Petitioner :- Indresh Dubey And Another
Respondent :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Petitioner :- Muneesh Raghuvanshi,Pramod Kumar Singh

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, Sri Nand Lal, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

By means of the present petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India, the petitioner has prayed to set aside the judgment and order dated 29.02.2024 passed by Additional District and Sessions Judge, Court No. 6, Azamgarh in Criminal Revision No. 1000005 of 2023 (Arvind Dubey and others Vs. State and another) and order dated 07.11.2022 passed by Judicial Magistrate,
Women Court, Azamgarh in Criminal Case No. 5269 of 2020 (State Vs. Arvind Dubey and others)
arising out of Case Crime No. 298 of 2013, under Sections 498A, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station-Jahanaganj, District-Azamgarh.

entities.text: Indresh Dubey And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Petitioners being Jeth and Jethani of the first informant are living separately and have been falsely implicated in a matrimonial dispute.

The discharge application moved by the petitioners has been rejected vide order dated 07.11.2022 on the basis of false and frivolous ground and even the Criminal Revision preferred by the petitioners is also rejected in the absence of the counsel for the petitioners.
It has also been submitted that petitioner No. 1 Indresh Dubey is working at New Delhi and the petitioner No. 2 Nisha along with her children residing at Raebareli.

Considering the fact that the petitioners are residing separately and had no role in the alleged incident, and in the absence of the counsel for the petitioners, impugned order has been passed which is against the interest of justice.

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the orders dated 29.02.2024 and 07.11.2022 are hereby set aside giving a fresh opportunity to the petitioners to move a discharge application within a period of three weeks from the date of order which shall be decided within two weeks thereafter in accordance with law after giving opportunity to both the parties and subject to their cooperation if,
there is no other legal impediment.
With the aforesaid direction
